name: Human.X
summary: The humanoid line from ROKAE, an established Chinese industrial-arm maker, which gives it a factory-integration story most humanoid startups lack. Human.X pairs a vision-language-action model with imitation and reinforcement learning for autonomous task decomposition, and is sold alongside more than fifteen packaged deployment scenarios.
notable: From an established industrial robot-arm manufacturer
Sold with packaged factory deployment scenarios
